contributions.detail: TWO Schedule A sheets. p2 (typed, 15 entries): 110 + 250 + 300 + 100 + 410 + 250 + 1000 + 100 + 1000 + 1000 + 250 + 5000 + 1000 + 3000 + 500 = 14,270.00 = that sheet's printed 'Subtotal for this page $ 14,270'. p3 (handwritten, 1 entry): 500.00 = its printed 'Subtotal for this page $ 500'. 14,270 + 500 = 14,770.00 = the printed 'Total Contributions Received $ 14,770' = Box B. Box C 'Contributions Received Year to Date' prints the SAME 14,770 (this is the filer's first report of the cycle, so period = year-to-date) and is still never summed as an increment. The ladder closes on the page: Box A 232.80 + Box B 14,770 = Box F 15,002.80, minus Box D 12,238.52 = the printed close 2,764.28.

notes: modern_boxAF, revision 'v. 4.20' (footer), born-digital fillable form filled by typing, printed and scanned in colour; 5 pages, each classified from its own printed header: p1 cover, p2 SCHEDULE A sheet 1 (typed, foliated 'Page 1'), p3 SCHEDULE A sheet 2 (HANDWRITTEN, foliated 'Page 2', a single entry), p4 SCHEDULE B (typed, foliated 'Page 1'), p5 SUMMARY PAGE (LAST, located by its heading). A TWO-SHEET Schedule A is the first in this chunk and is why the contribution anchor is the 'Total Contributions Received (Sum of all Schedule A pages)' figure rather than a single page subtotal. PAGE-FACE candidate name 'R Nathan Ivie' vs the channel label 'Nathan Ivie'; page-face office reads 'Utah County Commission' with NO SEAT LETTER, while index.csv carries 'County Commission Seat C' from the channel — the seat is NOT inferred here, the page face governs and the divergence is recorded. Report type: 'Seven days preceding the Primary Election' (single radio), amendment = 'No' (ticked). REDACTION: the filename says '_Redacted' but only the SIGNATURE is blacked out — every donor address line is published in the clear by the county (ADDENDUM I4's 'a filename is not evidence of redaction', seen from the other direction). All 16 donor rows and all 14 vendor rows are therefore reduced to city/state at READ TIME by this transcription, not by the county; no street line reaches this record. Every date on both schedules is a bare month/day (or '19 June') with NO YEAR, so every row carries needs_review=1 and no year was filled in from the 22 June 2020 report date. The ladder closes exactly on the page (232.80 + 14,770 - 12,238.52 = 2,764.28) and that closing balance is the Box A of this filer's next report (54634fa8, 27 July 2020) — noted as an observed chain, not used as a gate. Foliation: the schedules number 'Page 1/Page 2' per SCHEDULE (not per document) and the cover and summary sheets leave the Page box blank — a per-schedule foliation practice.
